pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, non-convex polygonal patches with highly serrated, toothed edges and sharp pixel-level gradients. Patch size is largest on the upper flank, transitioning to smaller, fragmented shapes on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of high-luminance pathways with dense junction nodes. Corridor thickness is consistent on the neck and upper flank, becoming wider and less distinct on the ventral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The 1D silhouette of the mane shows a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged profile along the cervical-dorsal transition against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigment fading is observed on the ventral region, where the contrast between dark patches and light corridors is significantly diminished compared to the dorsal regions.
